name: Asagi Naohiro
source:
A savvy entrepreneur who produces a wide variety of dining establishments,
from high-end restaurants to bars.
He’s also quite the player when it comes to women… an unparalleled womanizer.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01006023.html/]dlsite[/url]]
